A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gating delay of the first photosensor chip of the PILATUS 300 K-W is not uniform over the whole chip.
the gate delay of hybrid pixel detectors is not uniform and the delay is not constant over the detector area.
the gating delay of the PILATUS detectors is non-uniform and depends strongly on the detector configuration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the gating uniformity between individual modules of PILATUS2 detectors should not be assumed to be better than 10–20 ns.
, for time-resolved measurements with PILATUS2 detectors, the gating delay of individual modules must be taken into account.
